verdict.rationale: Downloading a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for a framework backed by a cloud platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The probes only find an llms.txt file and markdown docs pages, which are LLM-friendly documentation rather than an API specification, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
